description: Who depends on a company, from what others say in their annual reports: every filer that names it, with the passage, and whether it reads as a supplier, customer or competitor. For supply chains no fund report shows. Read by rules, so check the passage.

also.description: Other names for it, such as TSMC.

limit.description: Most filers to read; default 20, and 10 on the hosted server.

name.description: The company or thing to follow, as filings write it, such as Taiwan Semiconductor.

since.description: Filed since this date; default about 15 months ago, so each filer's latest annual report is in.

name: exposure_map
title: Who depends on this company
